gate_contribution_maps.meaning: Window-averaged axial maps; shared scales; image-zero and uncomputed crop fill masked; no percentile clipping.

internal_corrections.meaning: Fixed B5 base and computed proposals; 49 paired patients; all removes every correction; not separately trained ablations or B0.

comparison_training.meaning: 49 matched validation patients; all paired outliers retained; means and pointwise 20,000-draw percentile intervals; separate completed-stage trajectories; unchanged [0,1] Dice axes.

mri_predictions.meaning: Actual prespecified validation subject 205; axial RAS 90 selected from median reference tumour coordinates, independent of scores. Top: MRI and reference. Bottom: independent B0, B5 base, B5 final and error differences. Original complete-volume metrics are unchanged; orthogonal previews retained outside the compact upload package.

robustness_combined.meaning: All 15 modality subsets and 8 deterministic local FLAIR damage conditions; all 49 patients per condition. Corruption dots retain all paired differences and full observed ranges; diamond means; panels have different axes. No baseline corruption/subset result is inferred.
